subject: Energy
title: Electric Vehicles Everywhere
description: Learn Electric Vehicles Everywhere in one minute.

hook.text: EVs are replacing combustion engines worldwide—over 14 million sold in 2023, representing 18% of all new car sales.

buildup.text: Electric motors convert 85–90% of energy into motion—gas engines waste 70–80% as heat, making EVs far more efficient.

discovery.text: Battery costs have fallen to $140/kWh—making many EVs cost-competitive with gas cars on a total ownership basis.

twist.text: China dominates EV production—BYD overtook Tesla as the world's largest EV maker by volume in late 2023.

climax.text: Electric trucks, buses, and two-wheelers are following—electrifying transport beyond just passenger cars.

punchline.text: Plug in, drive off—electric wheels are taking over.

quiz.question: What share of new car sales were EVs in 2023?
